intro: Choosing between Apple Dictation and Superwhisper depends on whether you want a free, system-level feature or a specialized AI-powered tool. Apple Dictation is built into macOS and works well for basic, short-burst tasks without setup. Superwhisper provides advanced AI capabilities, custom modes, and deeper control for users who dictate long documents or need AI assistance.
tldr: Apple Dictation is free, built-in, and ideal for casual, short-burst dictation.
Superwhisper offers advanced AI integration, custom prompt modes, and better handling for professional writing.
Lazur serves as a third option that combines screen-aware assistance with voice commands and dictation.
Choose Apple Dictation for simple tasks, Superwhisper for AI-heavy writing, or Lazur for screen-aware guidance.

blocks.text: Core differences between Apple Dictation and Superwhisper

Apple Dictation lives inside your macOS settings. You activate it with a shortcut like ⌘ Space or by selecting Edit > Start Dictation. It excels at simple, quick tasks like sending a message or jotting down a short reminder. Because it is part of the system, it requires no extra installation. On Apple Silicon Macs, it processes audio locally, which keeps your data private.

Superwhisper acts as a dedicated application. It focuses on high-performance transcription using the Whisper model. It allows for custom prompts, which means you can tell the app to write in a specific tone or format. It is particularly popular among developers who use it with AI coding tools like Cursor. You can configure it to handle complex workflows that Apple Dictation cannot touch.
Performance and accuracy in real world tasks

Accuracy rates for both tools are high in quiet environments. You can expect 93 to 96 percent accuracy for standard English. Apple Dictation handles common phrases well. However, it struggles with technical jargon. It lacks a way to add custom vocabulary. If you work in law, medicine, or software, you will find yourself fixing many errors.

Superwhisper uses more advanced models. You can define custom modes to help the AI understand your specific industry terms. This reduces the time you spend editing after you finish speaking. If you dictate long reports, this difference matters. Editing five errors per page is manageable. Editing fifty errors is a barrier to your flow.

Apple Dictation offers strong privacy on Apple Silicon Macs. You can check your System Settings > Keyboard to confirm that your audio stays on the machine. If you use an older Intel Mac, Apple sends your voice to their servers. You must decide if that fits your security requirements.

Superwhisper also emphasizes local processing. It works offline, which is a major benefit for those who handle sensitive information. Because it is a third-party app, you should review their specific privacy policy on their website. They offer more control over which AI models you use, including cloud-based options if you choose to enable them.
When to choose a third option

Sometimes, dictation is only half the battle. You might need to know where a button is in a complex app or how to perform a multi-step task. This is where Lazur helps. While Apple Dictation and Superwhisper focus on text, Lazur focuses on the screen. You hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything visible. Lazur answers out loud, draws a circle around the item, or guides you through a process one click at a time.
If you struggle with app menus, ask Lazur to point at the feature you need. It draws a label so you never lose your place.

blocks.text: Apple Dictation is free. It comes with your Mac. There is no subscription and no hidden cost. You get what you get.

Superwhisper has a free tier that covers basic voice-to-text. The Pro plan costs $8.49 per month when billed monthly. This gives you access to advanced features like custom AI models and file transcription. They offer yearly billing and a lifetime license option.

faq.question: Is Apple Dictation better than Superwhisper?
faq.answer: Apple Dictation is better for casual, free use. Superwhisper is better for professional, AI-assisted writing.

faq.question: Does Superwhisper work offline?
faq.answer: Yes, Superwhisper supports offline transcription, which works best on Apple Silicon Macs.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur for dictation?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur includes unlimited dictation on all plans, but its primary strength is screen-aware assistance.

verdict: Pick Apple Dictation if you only need to dictate short emails or messages occasionally and prefer a free, built-in tool. Choose Superwhisper if you require high accuracy for professional writing, custom AI prompts, or integration with coding tools. If you need help navigating your Mac, understanding your screen, or want an assistant that combines dictation with visual guidance, choose Lazur.
